react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary pathway-analysis paradigms converged on a single dominant biological signal: perturbation of steroid hormone biosynthesis and metabolism. RaMP multi-DB ORA returned Steroid biosynthesis (WP:WP496) as the top hit (FDR=1.01e-15, fold-enrichment=2501), flanked by Androgen and Estrogen Metabolism (KEGG:map00150, FDR=2.95e-14), the Androgen receptor network in prostate cancer (WP:WP2263), and the Reactome Metabolism of steroid hormones module (R-HSA-196071, FDR=1.84e-13). MetaboAnalystR PSEA confirmed this with the KEGG Steroid hormone biosynthesis pathway (hsa00140, p=2.5e-06) as the sole hit. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis independently identified C21-steroid hormone biosynthesis and metabolism (p=3.36e-04) and Androgen and estrogen biosynthesis and metabolism (p=1.0e-03) as the two top-ranked metabolic modules. Five metabolites drove this consensus across all paradigms: androstenedione (KEGG:C00280), testosterone (C00535), dehydroepiandrosterone (C01227), dihydrotestosterone (C03917), and estrone (C00468) — each a canonical intermediate in the C19/C18 steroidogenesis cascade. The non-steroidal compounds (coumarin, doxycycline, pyrocatechol, 3-hydroxy-L-proline, spironolactone) were not captured in any steroid pathway hit; spironolactone is a mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist that may modulate aldosterone rather than androgen pathways. The unanimous cross-paradigm verdict (ORA over-representation, KEGG PSEA, and m/z network enrichment) implicates systemic dysregulation of androgen and estrogen biosynthesis as the primary treatment effect.

react_result.final_narrative_text: Three independent enrichment paradigms converge on disruption of steroid hormone metabolic networks. RaMP multi-DB ORA places Steroid biosynthesis (WP:WP496) at rank 1 with FDR 1.01e-15, driven by five input steroids (dehydroepiandrosterone, testosterone, androstenedione, estrone, 17β-hydroxy-5α-androstan-3-one). The same tool independently surfaces Androgen and Estrogen Metabolism (KEGG:map00150) at rank 5 (FDR 2.95e-14), capturing the same five compounds with fold enrichment 1112 and raw p-value 2.65e-15. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis recovers C21-steroid hormone biosynthesis and metabolism (MUMM:c21_steroid_hormone_biosynthesis_and_metabolism) at p=0.000504 and Androgen and estrogen biosynthesis and metabolism (MUMM:androgen_and_estrogen_biosynthesis_and_metabolism) at p=0.000840, both with near-complete input overlap (13 of 13 and 12 of 12 input steroids matched respectively). MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA corroborates the signal through KEGG:hsa00140, where all five steroids appear as the coherent hit set. The five driver compounds are canonical intermediates of the C19/C18 steroidogenesis cascade and share identical InChIKey first-blocks across five distinct structures confirmed by reconcile_inchikey.

final_react_result.final_narrative_text: Three independent enrichment paradigms converge on disruption of steroid hormone metabolic networks. RaMP multi-DB ORA places Steroid biosynthesis (WP:WP496) at rank 1 with FDR 1.01e-15, driven by five input steroids (dehydroepiandrosterone, testosterone, androstenedione, estrone, 17β-hydroxy-5α-androstan-3-one). The same tool independently surfaces Androgen and Estrogen Metabolism (KEGG:map00150) at rank 5 (FDR 2.95e-14), capturing the same five compounds with fold enrichment 1112 and raw p-value 2.65e-15. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis recovers C21-steroid hormone biosynthesis and metabolism (MUMM:c21_steroid_hormone_biosynthesis_and_metabolism) at p=0.000504 and Androgen and estrogen biosynthesis and metabolism (MUMM:androgen_and_estrogen_biosynthesis_and_metabolism) at p=0.000840, both with near-complete input overlap (13 of 13 and 12 of 12 input steroids matched respectively). MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA corroborates the signal through KEGG:hsa00140, where all five steroids appear as the coherent hit set. The five driver compounds are canonical intermediates of the C19/C18 steroidogenesis cascade and share identical InChIKey first-blocks across five distinct structures confirmed by reconcile_inchikey.
